name: Fibroblast migration, apoptosis and fibrotic matrix control
rationale: Members regulate fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation, survival, collagen and extracellular matrix assembly and TGF-beta responsiveness in connective tissue repair; unlike the confusables (which add SMAD/TGF-beta signalling, miRNA processing or elastin/MMP turnover), this theme carries fibroblast migration and apoptosis control.

name: Organic cation transport with carnitine and choline metabolism
rationale: Members cover SLC-mediated organic cation/anion and di/tricarboxylate, pyruvate and alpha-ketoglutarate transport (incl. SLC22A5 carnitine transporter defect and proximal tubule development); carnitine synthesis and choline catabolism are what the transport-only confusables lack.

name: Enteric nervous system development via RET and endothelin
rationale: Members combine enteric/neural crest and midgut development and peristalsis with RET/GDNF-receptor and endothelin signalling (including vascular endothelin effects); confusables instead add catecholamine/adrenal development or GI smooth muscle contraction and lack RET/GDNF and endothelin blood-pressure members.

core: Stalled ribosome rescue and mRNA decay
name: No-go and non-stop mRNA decay with ribosome rescue
rationale: Members concern decay of aberrant mRNAs (no-go decay, pre-mRNA catabolism) and PELO:HBS1L/ABCE1 rescue of stalled ribosomes; confusables cover NMD/termination, translation initiation or ZNF598/RQC nascent-chain degradation instead.

core: Catecholamine reuptake and synaptic vesicle loading
name: Norepinephrine reuptake and synaptic vesicle loading and acidification
rationale: Members cover norepinephrine/epinephrine plasma-membrane uptake (SLC6A2, SLC6A3 defects) and neurotransmitter loading into acidified synaptic vesicles; the vesicle acidification and epinephrine/organic cation transport members are what the dopamine/monoamine-transport and catecholamine-metabolism confusables lack.

name: Telomerase telomere lengthening, replicative senescence and lifespan
rationale: Members cover telomerase holoenzyme assembly, telomere extension and protein recruitment to telomeres together with their proliferative consequences (replicative senescence, adult lifespan, growth rate, bone marrow and inner cell mass proliferation); the confusables share the telomerase core but add Cajal body trafficking, telomere capping/recombination or C-strand synthesis and lack the lifespan/senescence members.

name: Left-right asymmetry of visceral organs via Nodal signalling
rationale: All members concern left-right axis specification (lateral mesoderm, liver, pancreas, digestive tract, nodal cilium movement) and its Nodal signalling control; confusables are general motile cilium assembly, extracellular ligand sequestration or gastrulation/germ layer formation without the laterality members.

core: Antiviral innate immunity and interferon response
qualifier: nucleic acid sensing via RLR, endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING
name: Viral nucleic acid sensing and type I/III interferon response
rationale: Members span RIG-I/MDA5, TLR3/7/8/9 and cGAS-STING/AIM2 sensing, TBK1/IRF3/IRF7 activation, type I/III interferon production and ISG responses (ISG15, OAS, PKR) incl. HSE deficiencies and viral modulation; confusables instead focus on host restriction of viral life cycle steps or TRIF/IKK signalling and lack the sensor-to-interferon axis.

qualifier: very-long-chain fatty acids and ether lipids
name: Peroxisomal very-long-chain fatty acid and ether lipid metabolism
rationale: Members cover VLCFA elongation and acyl-CoA synthesis, peroxisomal beta- and alpha-oxidation (phytanate, pristanoyl-CoA, ABCD1/ALD), plasmalogen/ether and wax biosynthesis and linoleic/alpha-linolenic metabolism; confusables add cholesterol synthesis, omega-oxidation/CYP disorders or peroxisome fission and lack the VLCFA synthesis and ether-lipid members.

core: MHC class I antigen processing and presentation
name: MHC class I antigen presentation including cross-presentation
rationale: Members cover peptide loading and assembly of MHC class I, cytosol-to-ER transport and endosomal/phagosomal cross-presentation of exogenous antigens; confusables are MHC class II presentation, proteasome assembly or viral Nef/Vpu downregulation and lack the cross-presentation routes.

name: Chemokine-directed dendritic cell migration and maturation
rationale: Members cover chemokines and their receptors (CCR1/CCR7), chemotaxis/adhesion modules and the downstream PLC/PKC and Cdc42 signalling, with dendritic cell chemotaxis, maturation and survival (plus NK chemotaxis); confusables centre on T cell, B cell or monocyte migration and lack the dendritic cell members.

qualifier: in embryonic head and diaphragm morphogenesis
name: Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing and release in embryonic morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern Hedgehog precursor self-cleavage, palmitoylation defects, ERAD of mutants and release of Hh-Np, together with Hh-dependent morphogenesis (anterior head, neurocranium, diaphragm) and cell localisation; confusables are downstream SMO/GLI signalling, Notch O-glycosylation, generic palmitoylation or Wnt secretion and lack the morphogenesis members.

qualifier: PIEZO1 mechanosensing with SRF actin targets
name: Endothelial shear stress mechanosensing and SRF-driven actin cytoskeleton
rationale: Members are endothelial responses to laminar and oscillatory shear stress via PIEZO1/PECAM1/integrins plus SRF-target actin cytoskeleton and contraction modules; confusables cover smooth muscle development/phenotypic switching, eNOS trafficking or perivascular/endothelial identity modules and lack either the shear-stress or the SRF members.

name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signalling in salivary gland branching morphogenesis
rationale: Members are reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling and the epithelial/mesenchymal proliferation and branching it controls in salivary gland (and limb bud) morphogenesis; confusables concern lung mesenchyme, other gland/organ development, prostate or pancreatic lineages instead.

name: Metanephric tubule segment and glomerular mesangium development
rationale: Members cover development of proximal/distal tubule, loop of Henle and collecting duct segments, glomerular mesangial, endothelial and vascular development, kidney cell proliferation/migration and glomerular filtration; confusables are early nephrogenesis (ureteric bud, MET), podocyte/basement membrane, or lung/pancreas epithelia.

qualifier: fructose catabolism disorders and alditol metabolism
name: Fructose catabolism and polyol metabolism
rationale: Members are fructose catabolism and its inborn errors (essential fructosuria, hereditary fructose intolerance) plus alditol (sugar alcohol) synthesis and breakdown; confusables cover glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, pentose/glucuronate or glycerol metabolism instead.

core: Viral RNA replication and translation in host cells
qualifier: mRNA capping and evasion of PKR/IFIT effectors
name: Viral mRNA capping, translation and antiviral effector evasion
rationale: Members cover viral genome replication (SARS-CoV-1/2), 7-methylguanosine capping, viral mRNA translation and termination-reinitiation, and viral blockade of PKR, IFIT and host mRNA processing/silencing; confusables are replicase maturation/frameshifting or influenza/RSV RNP synthesis and lack the capping and effector-evasion members.

name: Glycerophospholipid biosynthesis and acyl-chain remodelling
rationale: Members are de novo synthesis (CDP-choline, CDP-DAG; PC, PE, PS, PG, cardiolipin) and Lands-cycle acyl-chain remodelling of each glycerophospholipid class; confusables cover glycerophospholipid catabolism/lysophospholipid hydrolysis, endocannabinoid/DAG metabolism or sphingolipids.

core: Nuclear pore complex and nucleocytoplasmic transport
qualifier: mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown and ESCRT-III resealing
name: Nuclear pore complex and mitotic nuclear envelope remodelling
rationale: Members cover NPC assembly, localisation and transport (ribosomal subunit, inositol phosphate and Rev/HIV RNA traffic) together with mitotic NPC/lamina disassembly and nuclear envelope reformation and ESCRT-III sealing; confusables are chromosome condensation/cohesion, SUMOylation or mRNA export/NLS import and lack the envelope-remodelling members.

qualifier: negative regulation of IFN and cGAS-STING signalling
name: Type I interferon response and its negative feedback control
rationale: Members cover IRF3-driven type I IFN induction, cellular responses to IFN-alpha/beta and OAS effectors together with their restraint (TREX1, negative regulation of IFN-beta production, type I IFN signalling and cGAS/STING); the larger antiviral confusables emphasise sensor activation (RLR, TLR7/8/9, DC cytokines) and lack the IFNA/IFNB signalling regulation members.

qualifier: docking and priming through endocytic recycling
name: Presynaptic synaptic vesicle cycle from docking to recycling
rationale: Members cover neurotransmitter release cycles (glutamate, monoamines, acetylcholine), vesicle docking, priming, SNARE assembly and Ca2+-dependent fusion, plus vesicle endocytosis, clathrin uncoating, recycling and active zone/presynaptic cytoskeleton maintenance; confusables focus on presynaptic modulation/Ca2+ channel control of exocytosis or postsynaptic receptor trafficking and lack the recycling members.

name: Two-pore domain potassium channels setting resting membrane potential
rationale: Members are the K2P leak channel families (TWIK, TREK, TASK, THIK, TRESK) and regulation of resting membrane potential; confusables are pain perception, voltage-gated/Kir/Ca2+-activated K+ channels or TALK/TRP acid sensing.

core: Interferon-alpha and type III interferon response
name: Type III and alpha interferon response with chemokine induction
rationale: Members cover cellular responses to IFN-alpha and type III interferon, type III IFN production, OAS effectors and cytosolic DNA/virus sensing, together with IP-10, CCL5 and STAT6 chemokine induction; the broad antiviral confusables centre on RLR/TLR sensing and type I IFN or viral restriction and lack the type III IFN and chemokine members.

name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan, glycolipid and sialoglycan catabolism
rationale: Members are lysosomal degradation of heparan, chondroitin/dermatan and keratan sulfate and hyaluronan (all MPS disorders), gangliosides/glycosphingolipids (HEXA/HEXB), oligosaccharides and sialic acid (NEU1, GNE, N-acetylneuraminate); confusables are GAG/proteoglycan biosynthesis and O-glycosylation or hexosamine/N-glycan synthesis.

name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism
rationale: All members are phenylalanine metabolism (incl. phenylketonuria) and tyrosine catabolism; confusables are glycine/glyoxylate, threonine or histidine catabolism and generic amino acid terms.
